name: CLIMAX ZONE RE
source: This novel is inspired by the movie "Planet of Apes" and it features three female students from a space military academy who are shipwrecked on a penal colony formerly used as a prison and their rough adventure there.
translation: 本作灵感源自电影《人猿星球》，讲述了三名宇宙军校的女学生因飞船失事流落到一颗曾被用作监狱的流放星球，并在那里经历的一场惊险粗砺的冒险。
